images.title: Copper Street Locksmith
images.note: Following the street goblin’s warmth and specificity: a practical specialist whose small magic belongs naturally to his trade.
images.prompt: At goblin eye level beside an old teal-painted street door, an older MALE goblin locksmith works in a patch of clear afternoon sunlight. Small wiry body, a broad hooked nose, tremendous triangular ears, uneven lower teeth, tired amused amber eyes, thinning black hair tied at the back. Distinctly nonhuman and individual, not cute animation design. He wears a simple ochre wool waistcoat over rolled grey linen sleeves, a red neckerchief and one practical tool pouch. His left hand cups the removed palm-sized brass lock on a low workbox. Above his relaxed right palm, THREE tiny brass tumblers hover a few centimetres apart, held by a modest direct spell while he studies them; no strings, diagram, gauntlet or visible power device. Five plainly connected fingers on each hand, simple natural posture. A half-eaten pear sits at the edge of the workbox. Strong warm ochre and copper against teal wood; the street behind is only several sunlit masonry shapes and a soft burgundy awning. A characterful face and convincing little mechanical parts are focal; lower clothes and street fall into broader quiet strokes. The pleasure is his unhurried expertise and slightly mischievous expression.

images.title: A Coalback’s First Frost
images.note: Returning to a favourite creature at a smaller, intimate scale: warmth, believable anatomy and a proposed glimpse of its nesting life.
images.prompt: Recompose the attached coalback painting into a completely new intimate creature scene while preserving the original coalback anatomy: a small roughly forty-centimetre-long supple brown-furred animal with soft pointed muzzle, small ears, strong digging forepaws, thick furry tail and broad rust-colored overlapping keratin plates on its back. It is NOT a pangolin, dragon or mascot. Now one adult and one much smaller juvenile are tucked beneath the roots of a roadside tree at first frost. The adult lies curled along the root hollow, its muzzle close to one softly glowing piece of charcoal; the juvenile sleeps against its flank with its nose under the adult's thick tail. Their four-limbed mammalian bodies must be coherent even where partially hidden. Hoarfrost covers only the outer dry leaves and root tips. The nest's brown grasses and fur take a little ember warmth, surrounded by muted blue early-morning frost. Low close view, the faces, one forepaw and three or four back plates most resolved; the root hollow and distant verge quiet grouped paint. Gentle delight and observed animal intimacy, not saccharine cartoon eyes, human smiles, magical flame breath or an epic wildlife-hunting print. No humans or cookpot in the composition.

images.title: The Stone Opens
images.note: A second large spell with a different language: mass, fracture and mineral light, drawing on the quarry singer and Unmake the Pattern.
images.prompt: A breathtaking high-fantasy earth-magic scene at the blocked entrance to an ancient mountain road. Two immense slabs of pale sedimentary stone are being eased APART by an unseen force, splitting the old rockfall along believable layers. Their upper edges tower above the few human figures, but the bases remain grounded and pivot on rubble; nothing flies away as a magic vehicle. Through the newly opening tall crooked gap pours brilliant honey-colored late-afternoon sunlight, cutting across cool slate-purple dust and revealing the continuation of the road and a remote green valley. A small ordinary adult woman caster in a plain dark green travelling coat stands to one side in the foreground, feet firmly planted, both hands calmly held out about waist height, shoulders and torso connected; she is small against the stone, not an idealized heroine portrait. Three travellers with one pack mule wait farther back. The caster and a few falling pebbles establish that this is a living event, not a static landscape. Magic appears as a few warm mineral seams briefly brightening deep inside the separating rock, and very localized suspended dust; no luminous strings, glyph diagrams, machinery or crystals glued onto clothing. Low wide viewpoint, enormous readable stone masses, clear gap of light, active falling dust and tiny people. The focal opening is precisely shaped; the near rock's broad planes and distant valley are painterly and selectively simplified. Monumental wonder with weight and believable geology, no explosive fireworks.
